title: Alexa contracts: plugin skeleton, typed seams and generator skeleton (wave 0)
description:
Wave 0 of PPY-704ae1. One small PR that every parallel task builds on. After it merges, wave 1 tasks only add files in their own folders.

Deliver:
- amplify/plugins/alexa/: config.ts (AlexaConfig: invocationName, skillId optional until created, locales ["en-US"], accountLinking on/off, listing fields), papyrus.plugin.ts (manifest contract 1, no models, no guest mutations), registered in registry.ts.
- function/: a TypeScript Lambda via Amplify defineFunction, with ask-sdk-core and aws-jwt-verify added to package.json in this PR only. Module layout with typed interfaces and stub implementations:
  - handler.ts (skill builder, skill-ID check)
  - intents/index.ts (registry that later tasks add files to)
  - content/source.ts (PublicStorySource interface)
  - auth/linked-user.ts (LinkedUser | null)
  - apl/ (document loader + interface check)
  - speech/ssml.ts (interface)
- wire(): the Lambda permission for alexa-appkit.amazon.com with the skill-ID condition (when skillId is set), outputs the function ARN, no secrets in publicSettings.
- skill-package generator skeleton: scripts/alexa/generate-skill-package.ts producing skill.json + interaction model from the resolved config (deterministic), and an npm script test:alexa that later tasks add to.
- Feature skeletons: features_backend/alexa-*.feature (or the repo's TS spec location for plugins) with one passing scenario each for: plugin off, endpoint rejects the wrong skill ID, launch returns a response.
- Wire test:alexa into .github/workflows/tests.yml.

Done when: CI is green, the PR is merged, and the seam interfaces are documented in docs/alexa.md (short).
